715442.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure you can switch this computer's network connection off and on (such as Wi-Fi).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
715442.custom_steps:
1. Switch the computer's network connection off.
  2. Change the as-of date to yesterday.
  3. Switch the network back on.
  4. Change the as-of date back to today.
715442.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The computer is offline.

Step 2:

  • The report tries to load and fails: in place of the rows it shows "Something went wrong loading this report. Please try again.", with the standard error message as well.

Step 3:

  • The computer is online again.

Step 4:

  • The report loads normally again.

A server error cannot be caused by hand; a lost connection is the failure a tester can cause.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-R6: “If a report fails to load, it shows "Something went wrong loading this report. Please try again." in place of the rows, with the standard error message.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Report fails to load | "Something went wrong loading this report. Please try again." | In place of the rows, plus the standard error toast”

Last checked against build v26.45.2-6a8b89c (QA site sv11315) on 11/10/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html). The design draws no picture of this behaviour (all 7 boards and 45 figures checked); the case follows the PRD.

AUTOMATION: READY

1062582.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure you can switch this computer's network connection off and on (such as Wi-Fi).
  • Have a customer with an open invoice not yet due on today's date, so the "Current" bucket has lines.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
1062582.custom_steps:
1. Switch the computer's network connection off.
  2. Expand the "Current" bucket.
  3. Switch the network back on.
  4. Collapse the "Current" bucket.
  5. Expand the "Current" bucket.
1062582.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The computer is offline.

Step 2:

  • In place of its lines the bucket shows "Something went wrong loading this bucket. Collapse and expand it to try again."

Step 3:

  • The computer is online again.

Step 4:

  • The bucket collapses.

Step 5:

  • Its lines load and the invoice is listed; the message is gone.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

1062583.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure you can switch this computer's network connection off and on (such as Wi-Fi).
  • Have a bucket, bucket A, with more than 100 lines on today's date, so its later lines load as you scroll.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
1062583.custom_steps:
1. Expand bucket A.
  2. Switch the computer's network connection off.
  3. Scroll down to the end of bucket A's lines.
  4. Switch the network back on.
  5. Collapse bucket A.
  6. Expand bucket A.
1062583.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Bucket A opens with its first 100 lines.

Step 2:

  • The computer is offline.

Step 3:

  • The 100 lines already shown stay, and under them the bucket shows "Not every line loaded. Collapse and expand this bucket to try again."

Step 4:

  • The computer is online again.

Step 5:

  • Bucket A collapses.

Step 6:

  • Bucket A opens with its first 100 lines again, with no message.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • Story 4, Error Handling: “If a bucket's later lines stop loading while the user scrolls, the lines already shown stay and the bucket shows "Not every line loaded. Collapse and expand this bucket to try again." under them.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “A bucket's later lines stop loading | "Not every line loaded. Collapse and expand this bucket to try again." | Inside the bucket, under the lines already shown”
  • S4-R4: “On A/R Detail and A/P Detail, expanding a bucket (by hand or with Expand all) shows its first 100 lines, then loads more as the user scrolls. This is as today on A/P Detail and new on A/R Detail, which today shows a whole bucket at once.”
